feature_name: Handle Field Constraint Errors in Local Baserow Upsert Service
description: Implement error handling for field constraint violations in the local Baserow upsert service. Currently, when creating or updating rows through Builder Workflow Actions that violate field constraints (like unique constraints), the service crashes with an unhandled exception. Add proper exception handling to catch these constraint violations and return appropriate error responses instead of crashing.
functional_requirements: Catch FieldDataConstraintException exceptions thrown by the database layer when upserting rows through the local Baserow service
Convert caught constraint violations into user-friendly error responses that can be displayed in the frontend
Ensure the service continues to handle other types of errors appropriately while adding specific handling for constraint violations
